messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from today's authz postmortem. Short summary: overlapping token rotations + deploy ordering produced a 90-120s window of stale claims across the gateway fleet, and our audit pipeline lost a ~30s slice during a Kafka rebalance. We need owners, concrete short-term mitigations, and a closure checklist so this doesn't recur.
josh: Can you paste the minimal repro and the immediate mitigations you'd accept?
sara: Minimal repro in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2296001122. Steps: rotation job updates secret -> validators restart -> gateway serves cached claims until TTL or a 401 triggers revalidation; if revalidation coincides with consumer rebalance + GC, some audit events don't persist. Quick mitigations: 1) gate validator restarts on a rotation commit, 2) invalidate cache on rotation event, 3) add synchronous revalidate-on-401 with tight timeout, 4) add a small local buffer + idempotent retry in the audit shipper.
lia: I can own the cache invalidation + event hook. Plan: add a rotation webhook that triggers a TTL-bypass invalidation for affected keys and a feature flag to roll it out. Small PR. ETA: Wed EOD.
josh: I'll own revalidate-on-401 with a 150ms sync call and a simple circuit (fail open after X attempts) to avoid thundering herd. I'll add integration tests that simulate deploy order and token swap. ETA: Mon.
infra-sre: I'll implement a short-term audit-shipper buffer (60s), idempotent sink retries, and tune consumer-lag alerts to page at kafka.consumer.lag > 2500. Also suggest a temporary deploy throttle for rotation waves. ETA: tomorrow AM.
sara: Good. Let's capture action items here so oncall has a single source of truth: 
- [ ] LIA: PR for rotation -> cache-invalidate webhook (feature flag).
- [ ] JOSH: revalidate-on-401 sync call + circuit + integration tests.
- [ ] INFRA-SRE: audit-shipper buffer + idempotent retries + alert tuning.
- [ ] SARA: update runbook with emergency rollback, sample curl, and an operator checklist for token refresh.

sara: Sample curl for oncall repro: 
`curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROTATED_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/resource`
If you see a 401 spike: run `./scripts/force-refresh-tokens --service gateway --dry-run` then escalate to infra-sre.
lia: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runtime/pulls/1987 - feature flag `auth.invalidate_on_rotation_v3`. Requesting review from @josh and @infra-sre.
josh: Test PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/gateway/pulls/267 - revalidate-on-401 + deploy-order e2e and latency guard.
infra-sre: Infra PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/pulls/1034 - buffer + idempotent retry + consumer-lag alert. Added temporary throttle for rotation jobs (1 concurrent per region).
sec-bot: Created SEC-3491: "rotation-sweep-closure" linked SRV-4982. Watchers: sara, josh, lia, infra-sre. Status: in_progress.
sara: Scheduling a short 20m handoff tomorrow 09:00 PST to walk rollout and rollback criteria. Please bring PR links, smoke tests, and kill-switch scripts. We'll run daily 10m standups for the first 3 working days.
josh: I'll bring integration test traces and the circuit parameters.
lia: I'll bring the webhook payload example and a one-liner to disable the feature flag.
infra-sre: I'll bring consumer-lag dashboards and the throttle config.
sara: Final operate ask: run a 2-week verification cadence: weekly snapshots of consumer-lag + a rotation smoke test after each rotation. Once all owners mark their tasks done and SEC-3491 passes the post-implementation check, we'll close and mark recurrence mitigated. :thumbsup:
josh: ack
lia: ack
infra-sre: ack
sec-bot: SEC-3491 status updated: owners assigned, due date set."
